title: Upper Lower Split
author: Zach D.
desc: Build Size in all muscles by using hypertrophy style workouts. Maximize results by following a nutrition program and adding in cardio throughout the week.

ex.note: If you need to start with just bodyweight do that. Add weight once the exercise becomes easy at body weight. Follow progressive overload with this for whole program.
If your gym has kettlebells use these. Do a weight that is challenging but you can do for at least a minute. While walking make sure to take very controlled steps and keep your core tight.
Since you can't increase weight on this exercise you can either increase difficulty (legs higher, slower descent, pause at the top) or increase reps.
The last two sets are drop sets. Peel off some weight and do another 8-12 reps with less rest than the heavier sets. Make sure to warm up properly with light weight first on this one too.

ss.note: this exercise is superset with cable crunch. Do both arms on the lateral raise then do the crunches. Rest 60 seconds and repeat.  There are six sets but only 3 sets per arm.

ex.note:
Make sure to do warm up sets on this exercise. Make sure to sit in the bottom position to make sure the quads are feeling stretched and loose.
You can also increase difficulty by elevating front foot.
Increase weight on the sled as you get better at it. Instead of time you can also do a specific distance. You will be pushing the sled not pulling it.
Warm up sets!

ss.note: make sure to keep elbows still and really control the descent.
